datasets.label: nf-core/test-datasets rangeland minimal test dataset
datasets.description: Public nf-core minimal test dataset for the rangeland pipeline (rangeland branch of nf-core/test-datasets): Landsat Collection 2 Level-1 scenes for WRS-2 path/row 181/036, a DEM, a water vapour database, the datacube definition, an area-of-interest vector, and the Hostert 2003 endmember file. Used to exercise the full pipeline; it is not the Mediterranean study input.
datasets.access_statement: Publicly available under the nf-core/test-datasets licence.
